Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, g As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D4").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array(1, 3, -2, 4), Array(-1, 2, -3, 4), Array(5, 4, 3, 2), Array(2, 2, 2, 2))))
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = g.Points.Markers.Visible & " " & g.Points.Highpoint.Visible & " " & g.Points.Lowpoint.Visible & " " & g.Points.Firstpoint.Visible & " " & g.Points.Lastpoint.Visible & " " & g.Points.Negative.Visible
    Case 1
        Tried = g.Points.Markers.Color.Color & " " & g.Points.Highpoint.Color.Color & " " & g.Points.Negative.Color.Color
    Case 2
        Tried = TypeName(g.Points) & " " & TypeName(g.Points.Markers) & " " & TypeName(g.Points.Markers.Color) & " " & TypeName(g.Axes) & " " & TypeName(g.Axes.Horizontal) & " " & TypeName(g.Axes.Vertical) & " " & TypeName(g.Axes.Horizontal.Axis) & " " & TypeName(g.SeriesColor)
    Case 3
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.IsDateAxis
    Case 4
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.RightToLeft
    Case 5
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.Axis.Visible & " " & g.Axes.Horizontal.Axis.Color.Color
    Case 6
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.MinScaleType & " " & g.Axes.Vertical.MaxScaleType
    Case 7
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMinScaleValue & " " & g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMaxScaleValue
    Case 8
        Tried = g.DisplayBlanksAs & " " & g.DisplayHidden & " " & g.PlotBy
    Case 9
        Tried = g.Points.Negative.Visible & " " & TypeName(g.Points.Parent)
    Case 10
        g.Points.Markers.Visible = True
        Tried = g.Points.Markers.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c10.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 11
        g.Points.Highpoint.Visible = True
        Tried = g.Points.Highpoint.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c11.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 12
        g.Points.Lowpoint.Visible = True
        Tried = g.Points.Lowpoint.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c12.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 13
        g.Points.Firstpoint.Visible = True
        Tried = g.Points.Firstpoint.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c13.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 14
        g.Points.Lastpoint.Visible = True
        Tried = g.Points.Lastpoint.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c14.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 15
        g.Points.Negative.Visible = True
        Tried = g.Points.Negative.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c15.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 16
        g.Points.Markers.Color.Color = vbBlue
        Tried = g.Points.Markers.Color.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c16.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 17
        g.Axes.Horizontal.Axis.Visible = True
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.Axis.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c17.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 18
        g.Axes.Horizontal.Axis.Color.Color = vbRed
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.Axis.Color.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c18.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 19
        g.Axes.Vertical.MinScaleType = xlSparkScaleGroup
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.MinScaleType
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c19.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 20
        g.Axes.Vertical.MaxScaleType = xlSparkScaleCustom
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.MaxScaleType
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c20.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 21
        g.Axes.Vertical.MaxScaleType = xlSparkScaleCustom: g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMaxScaleValue = 7
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMaxScaleValue
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c21.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 22
        g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMaxScaleValue = 7
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMaxScaleValue & " " & g.Axes.Vertical.MaxScaleType
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c22.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 23
        g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMinScaleValue = -2.5
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMinScaleValue & " " & g.Axes.Vertical.MinScaleType
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c23.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 24
        g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMaxScaleValue = 1E+300
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.CustomMaxScaleValue
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c24.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 25
        g.Axes.Vertical.MinScaleType = 9
        Tried = g.Axes.Vertical.MinScaleType
    Case 26
        g.DisplayBlanksAs = xlZero
        Tried = g.DisplayBlanksAs
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c26.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 27
        g.DisplayBlanksAs = xlInterpolated
        Tried = g.DisplayBlanksAs
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c27.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 28
        g.DisplayBlanksAs = xlNotPlotted
        Tried = g.DisplayBlanksAs
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c28.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 29
        g.DisplayBlanksAs = 7
        Tried = g.DisplayBlanksAs
    Case 30
        g.DisplayHidden = True
        Tried = g.DisplayHidden
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c30.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 31
        g.PlotBy = 1
        Tried = g.PlotBy
    Case 32
        g.Points.Markers.Visible = True: g.Points.Markers.Visible = False
        Tried = g.Points.Markers.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c32.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 33
        g.Points.Markers.Visible = "x"
        Tried = g.Points.Markers.Visible
    Case 34
        g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor = 5
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.Color & " " & g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c34.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 35
        g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor = 5: g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade = 0.4
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade & " " & g.SeriesColor.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c35.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 36
        g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade = 0.5
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade & " " & g.SeriesColor.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c36.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 37
        g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor = 5: g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade = -0.25
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade & " " & g.SeriesColor.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c37.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 38
        g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor = 5: g.SeriesColor.Color = vbRed
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor & " " & g.SeriesColor.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c38.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 39
        g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor = 0
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor
    Case 40
        g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor = 13
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor
    Case 41
        g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade = 2
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade
    Case 42
        g.Points.Negative.Visible = True: g.Type = xlSparkColumn
        Tried = g.Type & " " & g.Points.Negative.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c42.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 42
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
